source.calibration: Each selected source row was independently calibrated with Bchron 4.7.8 and IntCal20. calibratedRanges95 contains all target-95.4% highest-density calendar intervals, expressed as atlas calendar years; calibratedProbability records the discrete coverage returned by Bchron. Multi-modal intervals are retained. A calibrated date is evidence for that dated sample, not continuous occupation, a culture boundary, ancestry, language, or population.
